title: `Function.get_parameters()` returns the window name instead of the arguments for `foo(5) over win1`
spec:
This is the sqlparse library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests`.

```python
import sqlparse
f = sqlparse.parse('foo(5) over win1')[0].tokens[0]   # a sqlparse.sql.Function
f.get_parameters()
```
Expected: `[<Integer '5'>]`
Actual: `[<Identifier 'win1'>]`

I would also like to get at the window itself: please add `Function.get_window()`, returning the window part of the `OVER` clause (the `Identifier` `win1` here) and `None` for a function call without `OVER`.

Similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
acceptance: the reported example produces the expected output
the underlying problem is fixed, not just the reported input
